FILM EIGHT, the channel's FIRST 🧭 AAJ FILM and its first non-fable. That badge changes what
the pictures owe: this is a claim about a real coast, so the plates are Gahirmatha and the
Rushikulya mouth as they actually are, the turtles are olive ridleys and not the Panchatantra
tortoise, and there is no hero turtle in any shot. It carries no callouts, deliberately --
nobody in it speaks, and a bubble over a wild animal would make a factual film into a cartoon.
The primitive is `many`: 116 instances of one drawing that have to read as a crowd and not as
wallpaper. Instances are dealt to rows by inverse width, jittered, bricked, then relaxed until
nobody is drawn through anybody -- jitter alone cannot do both, and the layout refuses a crowd
that does not fit rather than shaving it silently.
